speaker: Doctor
text: Given the confirmed wall motion abnormalities and your history of hypertension, have you experienced any episodes of fainting or near-fainting, and do you have a family history of sudden cardiac death? REQUEST TEST: Coronary Angiography to evaluate for coronary artery disease.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Heart Failure with Preserved Ejection Fraction (HFpEF) secondary to Hypertensive Heart Disease. Despite the normal angiogram and echocardiogram, your confirmed wall motion abnormalities, hypertension, and symptoms of dyspnea and orthopnea are classic for diastolic dysfunction where the heart muscle is stiff and cannot fill properly, leading to backup of fluid into the lungs.
